case: domain-over-bytea array keyed edit with same-named shadow domain
contract: A same-named domain in the first search_path schema has a stricter CHECK than the target domain, so an unqualified cast would reject the four-byte element.
An explicit cast to the shadow domain returns SQLSTATE 23514 inside a savepoint; rollback to the savepoint leaves the transaction usable for the target edit.
The schema-aware keyed update emits a qualified target-domain array cast and succeeds while the shadow schema is active on the same transaction backend.
The stored target domain type, JSON value and array_send bytes match the pre-edit target oracle, and the sibling row remains unchanged.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_bytea_array_contract::value_contract_domain_over_bytea_array_preserves_binary_values_and_wire_bytes -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings
